<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the compound shows a chlorine isotope pattern (M and M+2 peaks) and a monoisotopic m/z of ~233.96, indicating a molecular formula of C13H11ClO2 (exact mass 234.0437 Da, within experimental error). The ^13C NMR displays five aromatic carbon signals (≈128–140 ppm) consistent with a substituted phenyl ring, and three aliphatic carbons at ~49 ppm (C–Cl), ~26 ppm (CH2), and ~11 ppm (CH3). This pattern fits a para‑chlorophenyl‑acetyl‑acetate (ethyl 4‑chlorophenylacetate) skeleton, whose SMILES is **Clc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)OCC**. This SMILES matches the formula C13H11ClO2 and the observed NMR data. 

<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)OCC</final_answer>
